## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Implement only the owner-bound slice tested by AC-1 and AC-2, with
   admitted durable/wire compatibility and reuse of lower-layer
   codecs/stores — the M-I slice: per-stage readiness/quote
   construction and validation over **supplied** binding inputs;
   quote both runners/policies/endpoints/strata, `N=2TR≥10T`,
   retries/regrades/instruments/unknown exposure/prices/resources/
   full archive/versions/backups/retention; distinguish 300 A/B
   subjects from H/O pairs; diagnose attainable precision. Actual
   numeric stage packets stay unresolved until HUMAN-H8 + stage
   gates bind real inputs — this ticket owns the reusable quote
   machinery and records, not the numbers.
2. Retain the regression/evidence and per-target acceptance mapping
   under `docs/build/runs/R5.42.md` and its PR record; index only
   actual results.
3. Consume predecessor contracts unchanged (R5.41 central protocol,
   R5.39 parity admission dimension map, R5.40 numerical validation,
   R5.34 ops stage-count/account cells, R5.27 rights/handoff). A new
   shared/persisted decision belongs in the owning ADR admission,
   never an implementation-local substitute.

## Plan

**Placement.** `crates/hh-eval/src/exposure_quote.rs` + battery
`crates/hh-eval/tests/r5_42.rs`. Same home as the R5.36–R5.41
method/protocol spine: hh-eval consumes the parity `DIMENSIONS`
vocabulary, `stats::kl_directional_bound` and the S.1
`MethodMetadata` contract unchanged; no new crate dep (records-in —
callers resolve R5.34 ops/R5.27 rights records and pass refs).

**Shape.** `build_quote(&QuoteDecl) -> Result<ExposureQuote,
QuoteError>` — pure, records-in, deterministic (no clocks/stores/
spend). Decl supplies: `currency` (unset ⇒ totals 0 micros + funding
blocker), packet `prerequisites` over the seven-name M-I vocabulary
(satisfied{ref}/unmet/unknown), and per-stage decls over the five
frozen stages (activation/pilot/parity/confirmation/replication):
design sizes `tasks`/`repeats`, declared pair/subject counts, the
full `PINS` binding-input set (bound{ref}/unresolved/unknown —
declared exactly once each), endpoint margin entries (dimension ∈
parity `DIMENSIONS`), quoted `policies`/`runners`/`strata`, resource
`COMPONENTS` lines (qty × unit-price-micros or unpriced), envelope
quantities, discordance scenarios and the forbidden flags
(`top_up`/`pool_from`/`cloud_fallback`/`outcome_conditioned`).

**Computed per stage.** Counts: `ab_subjects = 2·T·R` (floor
`2TR ≥ 10T` ⇔ R≥5) vs `ho_pairs = T·R` — structurally distinct
members, overrides must match or refuse (`CountMismatch`), a
subjects count on the pairs stage refuses (`CountConflation`).
Activation fixes `tasks == 1`. Envelope checks against the frozen
§9.2 ceilings (pilot ≤60 subjects/≤200 core-h/≤50 GiB plus the
per-subject caps; confirmation ≤300/≤900/≤200 GiB/≤14 d under the
same per-subject caps; parity/replication quote-only — no allocated
tranche). Exposure: qty × unit_price summed in micros — any
unpriced/missing/unbounded cell (`provider_unknown_exposure`
quantity set) ⇒ `exposure` blocker; currency unset ⇒ total 0.
Precision: parity-stage `kl_directional_bound` diagnostics at
η=.025 over `[0] + declared discordances` — half-widths vs each
endpoint's declared margin ⇒ attainable/infeasible/unresolved
(attainable diagnostics, never power). Readiness:
`ready_for_gate | blocked{blockers} | infeasible` — blockers drawn
from AC-2's vocabulary (pins/map/backend/rights/exposure/precision/
prerequisite/funding). Dispatch outcome: `not_requested |
refused{first blocker} | gate_pending{GATE-G12/G13/G14/—}` — never
an authorization. `quote_id = idp_digest` minted last inside one
Result; strict `to_json` + `check_id()`.

**Refusals (closed `QuoteError`).** `MissingKey`, `StageVocabulary`,
`DuplicateStage`, `PinVocabulary`, `DuplicatePin`,
`PrereqVocabulary`, `DuplicatePrereq`, `ComponentVocabulary`,
`DuplicateComponent`, `EnvelopeVocabulary`, `EnvelopeExceeded`,
`SubjectFloor`, `CountMismatch`, `CountConflation`,
`ActivationShape`, `RunnerSet`, `PolicySet`, `AutomaticTopUp`,
`PooledCapacity`, `CloudFallback`, `GuessedMargin`,
`FavorableShopping`, `EndpointVocabulary`, `MarginMap`.

**No-go lines.** No spend, no provider/backend calls, no input
choices (tasks/seeds/prices/margins supplied), no new dep/RecordKind/
event class/kernel arm, no dispatch authorization, no scientific
claim. USD stays $0.
